Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Claude
Message:
Security (PR8-4): don't log raw request bodies on body-parser errors

The final express error handler console.error'd the whole error object, which
for body-parser failures includes err.body (the full raw request body, e.g.
login credentials) and answered 500. Move the handler to
src/lib/requestErrorHandler.js: body-parser errors (entity.parse.failed,
entity.too.large, ...) now answer 400/413/415 with the existing
{status, message} JSON envelope and log only the error type and a truncated,
control-char-stripped message. Unknown errors that still carry a body are
logged without it. ENOENT->404 and multer-limit->413 behaviour is unchanged.
